translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai

tamam tarr tareef Allah ki hai jo aasmano aur zameen ka peda kernay wala hai , jiss ney unn farishton ko paygham ley janey kay liye muqarrar kiya hai , jo do do , teen teen aur chaar chaar peron walay hain . woh pedaeesh mein jitna chahta hai izafa ker deta hai .   beyshak Allah her cheez ki qudrat rakhney wala hai .

jiss rehmat ko Allah logon  kay liye khol dey , koi nahi hai jo ussay rok sakay , aur jissay woh rok ley to koi nahi hai jo uss kay baad ussay churra sakay . aur wohi hai jo iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

aey logo ! yaad kero unn naimaton ko jo Allah ney tum per nazil ki hain . kiya Allah kay siwa koi aur khaliq hai jo tumhen aasman aur zameen say rizq deta ho-? uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai . phir aakhir tum kahan ondhay chalay jarahey ho-?
aur ( aey payghumber ! ) agar yeh log tumhen jhutla rahey hain to tum say pehlay bhi payghumberon ko jhutlaya gaya hai . aur tamam moamlaat aakhir kaar Allah hi ki taraf lotaye jayen gay .

aey logo ! yaqeen jano kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , lehaza tumhen yeh dunyawi zindagi hergiz dhokay mein naa daalay , aur naa Allah kay moamlay mein tumhen woh ( shetan ) dhokay mein daalney paye jo bara dhokay baaz hai .
yaqeen jano kay shetan tumhara dushman hai , iss liye uss ko dushman hi samajhtay raho . woh to apney manney walon ko jo dawat deta hai , woh iss liye deta hai takay woh dozakh kay baasi ban jayen .
jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay liye shadeed azab hai , aur jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn kay liye maghfirat hai , aur bara ajar !

bhala batao kay jiss shaks ki nazron mein uss ki bad-amli hi khushnuma bana ker paish ki gaee ho , jiss ki bana per woh uss bad-amli ko acha samajhta ho , ( woh naik aadmi kay barabar kaisay hosakta hai-? ) kiyonkay Allah jiss ko chahta hai , raastay say bhatka deta hai , aur jiss ko chahta hai theek raastay per phoncha deta hai .   lehaza ( aey payghumber ) aisa naa ho kay inn ( kafiron ) per afsos kay maaray tumhari jaan hi jati rahey . yaqeen rakho kay jo kuch yeh ker rahey hain , Allah ussay khoob janta hai .

aur Allah hi hai jo hawayen bhejta hai , phir woh badalon ko uthati hain , phir hum unhen hanka ker aik aesay shehar ki taraf ley jatay hain jo ( qehat say ) murda hochuka hota hai , phir hum uss ( barish ) kay zariye murda zameen ko naee zindagi ata kertay hain . bus issi tarah insanon ki doosri zindagi hogi .

jo shaks izzat hasil kerna chahta ho , to tamam tarr izzat Allah kay qabazay mein hai . pakeezah kalma ussi ki taraf charrta hai , aur naik amal uss ko oopper uthata hai .   aur jo log buri buri makkariyan ker rahey hain , unn ko sakht azab hoga , aur unn ki makkaari hi hai jo malya mait hojaye gi .

aur Allah ney tumhen mitti say peda kiya , phir nutfay say , phir tumhen jooray jooray bana diya . aur kissi mada ko jo koi hamal hota hai , aur jo kuch woh janti hai , woh sabb Allah kay ilm say hota hai . aur kissi umar raseedah ko jitni umar di jati hai , aur uss ki umar mein jo koi kami hoti hai , woh sabb aik kitab mein darj hai .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh sabb kuch Allah kay liye boht aasaan hai .

aur do darya barabar nahi hotay . aik aisa meetha hai kay uss say piyas bujhti hai , jo peenay mein khushgawar hai , aur doosra karrwa namkeen . aur her aik say tum ( machliyon ka ) taza gosht khatay ho , aur woh zewar nikaltay ho jo tumharay pehanney kay kaam aata hai . aur tum kashtiyon ko dekhtay ho kay woh uss ( darya ) mein paani ko phaarti hoi chalti hain , takay tum Allah ka fazal talash kero ,   aur takay shukar guzaar bano .

woh raat ko din mein dakhil ker deta hai , aur din ko raat mein dakhil ker deta hai , aur uss ney sooraj aur chaand ko kaam per laga diya hai . ( inn mein say ) her aik kissi muqarrara miyaad tak kay liye rawan dawan hai . yeh hai Allah jo tumhara perwerdigar hai , sari badshahi ussi ki hai . aur ussay chorr ker jinn ( jhootay khudaon ) ko tum pukartay ho , woh khujoor ki guthli kay chilkay kay barabar bhi koi ikhtiyar nahi rakhtay .

agar tum unn ko pukaro gay to woh tumhari pukar sunen gay hi nahi , aur agar sunn bhi len to tumhen koi jawab nahi dey saken gay . aur qayamat kay din woh khud tumharay shirk ki tardeed keren gay . aur jiss zaat ko tamam baaton ki mukammal khabar hai , uss kay barabar tumhen koi aur sahih baat nahi bataye ga .
aey logo ! tum sabb Allah kay mohtaj ho , aur Allah bey niaz hai , her tareef ka bazaat-e-khud mustahiq .
agar woh chahye to tum sabb ko fana kerday , aur aik naee makhlooq wajood mein ley aaye .
aur yeh kaam Allah kay liye kuch bhi mushkil nahi hai .

aur koi bojh uthaney wala kissi doosray ka bojh nahi uthaye ga , aur jiss kissi per bara bojh lada huwa ho , woh agar kissi aur ko uss kay uthaney ki dawat dey ga to uss mein say kuch bhi uthaya nahi jaye ga , chahye woh ( jissay bojh uthaney ki dawat di gaee thi ) koi qareebi rishta daar hi kiyon naa ho . ( aey payghumber ! ) tum unhi logon  ko khabrdar ker-saktay ho jo apney perwerdigar ko dekhay baghair uss say dartay hon , aur jinhon ney namaz qaeem ki ho . aur jo shaks pak hota hai , woh apney hi faeeday kay liye pak hota hai . aur aakhir-kaar sabb ko Allah hi ki taraf loat ker jana hai .
aur andha aur dekhney wala barabar nahi hosaktay .
aur naa andheray aur roshni
aur naa saya aur dhoop
aur zinda log aur murday barabar nahi hosaktay , aur Allah to jiss ko chahta hai , baat suna deta hai , aur tum unn ko baat nahi suna saktay jo qabron mein parray hain .
tum to bus aik khabrdar kernay walay ho .
hum ney tumhen haq baat dey ker iss tarah bheja hai kay tum khushkhabri do , aur khabrdar kero . aur koi ummat aesi nahi hai jiss mein koi khabar daar kernay wala naa aaya ho .

aur agar yeh log tumhen jhutla rahey hain to jo ( kafir ) inn say pehlay thay , unhon ney bhi ( Rasoolon ko ) jhutlaya tha . unn kay payghumber unn kay paas khuli khuli nishaniyan ley ker , saheefay ley ker aur roshni phelaney wali kitab ley ker aaye thay .
phir jinn logon  ney inkar ki rawish apnai thi , mein ney unhen pakar mein ley liya . abb dekho kay meri saza kaisi ( holnaak ) thi !

kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay Allah ney aasman say paani utaara , phir hum ney uss kay zariye rang ba-rang kay phal ugaye-? aur paharon mein bhi aesay tukrray hain jo rang ba-rang kay safaid aur surkh hain , aur kalay siyah bhi .

aur insanon aur janweron aur chopayo mein bhi aesay hain jinn kay rang mukhtalif hain . Allah say uss kay bandon mein say wohi dartay hain jo ilm rakhney walay hain .   yaqeenan Allah sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , boht bakhshney wala bhi .

jo log Allah ki kitab ki tilawat kertay hain , aur jinhon ney namaz ki pabandi ker rakhi hai , aur hum ney unhen jo rizq diya hai , uss mein say woh ( naik kamon mein ) khufiya aur aelania kharch kertay hain , woh aesi tijarat kay umeedwaar hain jo kabhi nuqsan nahi uthaye gi .
takay Allah unn kay pooray ajar unn ko deydey , aur apney fazal say aur ziyada bhi dey . yaqeenan woh boht bakhshney wala , bara qadar daan hai .

aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumharay paas wahi kay zariye jo kitab bheji hai , woh sachi hai jo apney say pehli kitabon ki tasdeeq kerti hoi aai hai . yaqeenan Allah apney bandon say poori tarah ba-khabar , her cheez ko dekhney wala hai .

phir hum ney iss kitab ka waris apney bandon mein say unn ko banaya jinhen hum ney chunn liya tha .   phir unn mein say kuch woh hain jo apni jaan per zulm kernay walay hain , aur unhi mein say kuch aesay hain jo darmiyaney darjay kay hain , aur kuch woh hain jo Allah ki tofiq say naikiyon mein barhay chalay jatay hain . aur yeh ( Allah ka ) boht bara fazal hai .
hamesha basney kay baaghaat hain jinn mein woh log dakhil hon gay , wahan unn ko soney kay kangganon aur motiyon say aarasta kiya jaye ga , aur unn ka libas wahan per resham hoga .
aur woh kahen gay kay :  tamam tarr tareef Allah ki hai jiss ney hum say her ghum door kerdiya . beyshak humara perwerdigar boht bakhshney wala , bara qadardaan hai ,
jiss ney apney fazal say hum ko abadi thikaney kay ghar mein laa utaara hai jiss mein naa hamen kabhi koi kulfat choo-ker guzray gi , aur naa kabhi koi thakan paish aaye gi .

aur jinn logon  ney kufr ki rawish apna li hai , unn kay liye dozakh ki aag hai . naa to unn ka kaam tamam kiya jaye ga kay woh mar hi jayen , aur naa unn say dozakh ka azab halka kiya jaye ga . her nashukray kafir ko hum aesi hi saza detay hain .

aur woh uss dozakh mein cheekh pukar machayen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen bahir nikal dey takay hum jo kaam pehlay kiya kertay thay , unhen chorr ker naik amal keren .  ( unn say jawab mein kaha jaye ga kay : )  bhala kiya hum ney tumhen itni umar nahi di thi kay jiss kissi ko uss mein sochna samajhna hota , woh samajh leta-? aur tumharay paas khabrdar kernay wala bhi aaya tha .   abb maza chakho , kiyonkay koi nahi hai jo aesay zalimon ka madadgaar banay .
beyshak Allah aasmano aur zameen ki posheeda cheezon ka ilm rakhta hai . beyshak woh seenon mein chupi hoi baaton ko khoob janta hai .

wohi hai jiss ney tumhen zameen mein ( pichlay logon  ka ) janasheen banaya . abb jo shaks kufr keray ga to uss ka kufr ussi per parray ga . aur kafiron kay liye unn ka kufr unn kay perwerdigar kay paas ghazab kay siwa kissi aur cheez mein izafa nahi kerta , aur kafiron ko unn kay kufr say khasaray kay siwa kissi cheez mein taraqqi hasil nahi hoti .

. ( aey payghumber ! ) inn say kaho kay :  bhala batao tum Allah ko chorr ker apney jinn mann gharrat shareekon ko pooja kertay ho , zara mujhay dikhao kay unhon ney zameen ka konsa hissa peda kiya hai ? ya aasmano ( ki pedaeesh mein ) unn ki konsi shirkat hai ?  ya phir hum ney unhen koi kitab dey rakhi hai jiss ki kissi wazeh hidayat per yeh log qaeem hain-?   nahi , balkay yeh zalim log aik doosray ko khalis dhokay ki yaqeen dahani kertay aaye hain .

haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah ney aasmano aur zameen ko thaam rakha hai kay woh apni jagah say talen nahi . aur agar woh tall jayen to uss kay siwa koi nahi hai jo unhen thaam sakay . yaqeenan Allah bara burdbaar, boht bakhshney wala hai .

aur enhon ney pehlay baray zoron mein Allah ki qasmen khai then kay agar inn kay paas koi khabrdar kernay wala ( payghumber ) aaya to woh her doosri ummat say ziyada hidayat qubool kernay walay hon gay .   magar jab unn kay paas aik khabrdar kernay wala aagaya to uss kay aaney say unn ki halat mein aur koi taraqqi nahi hoi , siwaye iss kay kay yeh ( haq kay raastay say ) aur ziyada bhagney lagay ,

iss liye kay enhen zameen mein apni barai ka ghamand tha , aur enhon ney ( haq ki mukhalifat mein ) buri buri chaalen chalni shuroo kerden . halankay buri chaalen kissi aur ko nahi , khud apney chalney walon hi ko gheray mein ley leti hain .   abb yeh log uss dastoor kay siwa kiss baat kay muntazir hain jiss per pichlay logon  kay sath amal hota aaya hai ?   ( agar yeh baat hai ) to tum Allah kay tey shuda dastoor mein kabhi koi tabdeeli nahi pao gay , aur naa tum Allah kay tey shuda dastoor ko kabhi talta huwa pao gay .

aur kiya inn logon  ney zameen mein kabhi safar nahi kiya jiss say woh yeh dekhtay kay jo log inn say pehlay guzray hain , unn ka anjam kaisa huwa , jabkay woh taqat mein inn say boht ziyada mazboot thay ? aur Allah aisa nahi hai kay aasmano ya zameen ki koi cheez ussay aajiz ker-sakay . beyshak woh ilm ka bhi malik hai , qudrat ka bhi malik .

aur agar Allah logon  kay her kartoot per unn ki pakar kernay lagta to iss zameen ki pusht per kissi chalney walay ko naa chorta , lekin woh aik moyyan mauddat tak kay liye unn ko mohlat dey raha hai . phir jab unn ka muqarrara waqt aajaye ga , to Allah apney bandon ko khud dekh ley ga .
